units.meaning: For any temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to satisfy all four of the listed conditions (illuminating exits, keeping exits clear, appointing an adult steward, and providing an inspection record).

source_spans.quote: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to illuminate every public exit continuously throughout the entire time the display remains open.

source_spans.quote: The organizer must illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to keep every public exit clear continuously throughout the entire time the display remains open.

source_spans.quote: The organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises where exits must be kept clear, equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is expressly excepted from being deemed an obstruction of a public exit.

source_spans.quote: Equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is not an obstruction of a public exit.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
The organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open.

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is required to appoint an adult steward who must remain on site throughout the entire duration that the display remains open.

source_spans.quote: The organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer is exempt from the requirement to appoint an adult steward when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.

source_spans.quote: This appointment duty does not apply when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
The organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open.

units.meaning: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, prior to admitting the first visitor, the organizer is required to provide the agency with an inspection record in one of two permissible formats: a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

source_spans.quote: Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

units.meaning: During any active storm warning, the organizer is required to suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all three specified conditions (fixed roof, measured wind speed below 20 km/h, and officer authorization) are concurrently met.

source_spans.quote: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:

units.meaning: During an active storm warning, in order to avoid the mandatory suspension of outdoor demonstrations under the parent rule, the demonstration must take place beneath a fixed roof.

source_spans.quote: The demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof.
When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:

units.meaning: During an active storm warning, in order to avoid the mandatory suspension of outdoor demonstrations under the parent rule, the agency must have measured the wind speed at the demonstration site to be below 20 kilometers per hour within the preceding 10 minutes.

source_spans.quote: The agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes.
When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met:

source_spans.quote: An agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.

units.meaning: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer is advised and recommended (should) to place a readable map near the entrance.

source_spans.quote: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.

units.meaning: The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for daytime displays held entirely before sunset does not impose or establish a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.

source_spans.quote: This recommendation does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.

units.meaning: The organizer is required to retain each inspection record for a minimum threshold of at least 30 calendar days following the closure of the display.

source_spans.quote: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.

units.meaning: The minimum retention duration threshold for each inspection record is 30 calendar days following the closure of the display.

source_spans.quote: at least 30 calendar days after the display closes
The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.

units.meaning: In calculating the 30-calendar-day retention period for inspection records, weekends and holidays are expressly included and counted toward the 30 days.

source_spans.quote: Weekends and holidays count toward the 30 days.
The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes.

units.meaning: If an agency investigation remains open at the conclusion of the initial 30-calendar-day retention period, the organizer must continue to retain the inspection record until the agency officially closes the investigation.

units.meaning: Visitors are under no obligation and are exempt from any requirement to provide or supply their home addresses.
